name: Backstab
description: Every point of agility this unit has adds %dmg_bonus% damage to its attacks.

upgrade.summary: An attack that fails still lands %fail_multiplier:pct%% of the backstab damage.
details: An attack that is defended outright still delivers %fail_multiplier:pct%% of the backstab bonus.
The base form delivers none of it, so this is purely a gain - a failed swing stops being wasted.
